description: Start collecting an account's followers or following. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

limit.description: Max accounts to collect, default 2500. Larger lists take ~0.35 s per account.

username.description: Account to scan, without @. Omit for the logged-in account.

name: peers_scan
title: Peers scan
